1445-4871-5631-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5631-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

5231-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

628-3899-7197.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1170-2099-2350-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-2350-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

277-851-2557-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-1432-2404-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-1432-2404-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Ioreth of the Healing House any number of times.

4-1170-1636-7443.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Regrowth using convoke without paying mana.
4-1170-1636-7443.description:
Cast Regrowth using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Abundance.
When Emeritus of Abundance enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2092-3213-4549-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Boromir, adding {B}.
Activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

261-2034-3490-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-2034-3490-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

7-2034-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-2034-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {2} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

647-1171-1409.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

2757-3713-5078-5741.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1170-3536-5078-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-3536-5078-6979.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3499-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3912-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2921-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

5073-5220-5708-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1781-1978-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
1781-1978-6410.description:
Cause Howlsquad Heavy to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat from step 2.

862-2173-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1661-1766-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1409-2933-4785-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-4785-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

713-1947-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
713-1947-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

250-779.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2060-2445-3525-3574.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-2445-3525-3574.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-2445-3525-3574.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

962-1978-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
962-1978-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Yurlok's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana in their mana pool.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

751-3390-5496-6075.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
You have no other cards in your library with a mana value of 0.
751-3390-5496-6075.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake's cascade ability from Abaddon the Despoiler triggers, causing you to cast Lotus Bloom from your library since it is the only valid card to cast.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself to your hand.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Lotus Bloom from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

2871-4113-5851.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {2}, tapping Stormsplitter, and tapping Caetus.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Seething Anger resolves, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3} and tapping the token copy of Stormsplitter.
Both Stormsplitters trigger, creating two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Seething Anger resolves, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {2} and tapping two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Seething Anger resolves, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by tapping four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Repeat from step 8.

338-3490-3910-4772-5296.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
338-3490-3910-4772-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-3490-3910-4772-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1571-1827-4875-5728.notablePrerequisites:
Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Your life total is at least 3.
1571-1827-4875-5728.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library, then causing you to lose 2 life.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Conspiracy, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

2972-4772-5456.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
2972-4772-5456.description:
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

500-2103-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one Cormela token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the original Cormela and the token Cormela die, their abilities trigger, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2829-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
2829-5365-5366.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the Clue.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

856-1927-3765.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the Voldran Epicure trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House

1432-3388-4091.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.You control at least one additional legendary creature.
1432-3388-4091.description:
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Moritte and any other legendary creature you control.
Activate Moritte by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

2253-4688-4772.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating 26 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

182-4658.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
182-4658.description:
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Soul of Eternity's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
